title: Run dashboard CI follow-up through a custom CI rebuild trigger

intentCoverage.report:
**Verdict: Caught.** Maintained proof catches a plausible bypass of original-declaration coverage for the accepted custom repeat. This finding covers the omitted `integration` entry on the observed 106-second repeat.

**Next proof action:** Retain the existing regression assertion. This probe supports no new test repair; broader coverage remains outside this check.

Story: `.planning/seeds/SEED-330-dashboard-ci-follow-up.md#invoke-custom-ci-rebuilds`, plan 606, selected revision `7f85a3f8f10784c920207596922ad5e28c8c5c58` (implementation `d5a3a90511ce217261a186e23348e433a0b5fa34`). The promised full comparable repeat must have proof as complete as the original; omitted original work must remain unverified.

One fault in `dashboard/server/ciFollowUpAdapterObservation.ts:148` removed only `!declaredParts(request.original).every((part) => repeatedParts.has(part))` from the rejection condition, preserving the generic undefined-verdict completeness gate. Fixtures and assertions stayed unchanged.

Maintained case: `dashboard/backend-tests/intent/landed-ci-adapter-repeat-comparability.spec.ts:107`, “omitted original entry is not comparable even when remaining proof is complete.” Its original proof declares `tests` and `integration`; the repeat declares only `tests`, with all three cases and its sole part complete. The assertion that actually caught the fault was the first `retained` helper check in `dashboard/tests/support/ciFollowUpAdapterAssertions.ts:39`: expected `kind: "unverified"` and the incomplete-proof explanation, received `kind: "slow"` and “Possible CI slowdown.” The faulted run stopped at this initial check, before its restart checks.

An independent filesystem-event observer read the persisted follow-up ledger without altering product behavior or test sources. It confirmed that the exact accepted `pipeline/repeat` / `attempt:repeat` was observed successful with matching revision, `all-checks` / `push`, and bounds 07:00:00–07:01:46. Against the saved 100000 ms reference, the faulted ledger recorded `slow` despite original paths `[tests, integration]` and repeat paths `[tests]`. Baseline and restored observations recorded `unverified` with “Repeat measurement or comparable CI proof is incomplete.” This establishes reach and wrong product behavior separately from fault execution and the failing assertion.

All three runs used the same focused command, launched by the read-only observer with an owned private `TMPDIR`: `PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH" caffeinate -s -i env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES npx playwright test --config dashboard/playwright.config.ts dashboard/backend-tests/intent/landed-ci-adapter-repeat-comparability.spec.ts --grep 'omitted original entry' --workers=1 --reporter=list`. Baseline: 1 passed, exit 0. Faulted: 1 failed on the intended assertion, exit 1. Restored: 1 passed, exit 0. AC power was verified; one-minute loads were 29.82, 26.17 and 26.37 respectively. Setup used scratch-local native npm acquisition and passed Chromium prerequisite validation.

The detached scratch checkout `/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-N4cAjH` started clean at the selected revision. An exit/signal trap restored the fault. Source, spec and helper SHA-256 values matched their pre-fault values; Git status and tracked diff were empty before the restored run and again afterward. The scratch checkout, generated witnesses and worktree registration were removed successfully. No commit, push, backlog, findings or CI-observer action occurred. Concurrent coordinator changes in the parent were preserved.

This confirms plan slice 3’s existing omitted-entry regression proof; it does not introduce a new repair decision.

- **Test runtime.** Measured selected-test durations reported by Playwright: baseline 10.6 s, faulted 19.4 s, restored 13.3 s; total 43.3 s. Whole-run totals were 17.5 s and 17.2 s for the passing runs; the failed-run reporter omitted its whole-run total.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable: no separate human-time measurement was collected.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable: no separate active-time or token accounting was exposed for this check.

Invocation start was captured from the host clock at 2026-11-12 15:54:45 UTC, with one-second timestamp precision.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 246705 ms (measured), from 1794498885000 to 1794499131705 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

## Wrap-up disposition

Checked revision: 7f85a3f8f10784c920207596922ad5e28c8c5c58 (implementation d5a3a90511ce217261a186e23348e433a0b5fa34). Caught applies to the omitted original declaration path only. Retain the existing regression; no new correction or queue entry is warranted by this probe. Baseline/fault/restored observations and independent ledger witness establish reach, false slowdown and restoration. Parent changes since the check are documentation/closure records only; implementation and maintained assertions for this promise are unchanged. Product review found no separate follow-up plan. Scratch restoration and removal are confirmed. No actionable finding remains from this report.

The existing transferred finding in the published SEED-330#make-ci-follow-up-automatic coverage disposition is fulfilled: landed-ci-adapter-repeat.spec.ts's adapter-only case retains an admitted GitHub-shaped qualifying measurement, completes real collectCiFollowUps calls to terminal and observes zero rebuild/GitHub requests. No duplicate correction is needed; the receiving story is this completed work.
